description: This Java source file defines the REST API resource for journal entries in the Fineract platform. It includes endpoints for listing, retrieving, creating, updating, and downloading templates for journal entries, as well as handling file uploads for bulk import. The class is annotated with JAX-RS and Swagger annotations to specify API behavior and documentation. It interacts with service classes for business logic, security, serialization, and bulk import functionalities.

classes.name: JournalEntriesApiResource
classes.description: REST API resource class implementing journal entry operations such as list, retrieve, create, update, and import, annotated with JAX-RS and Swagger for documentation and REST semantics.

methods.name: retrieveAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list journal entries with support for pagination, sorting, and filtering parameters.

methods.name: retrieveJournalEntryById
methods.description: Handles GET request for retrieving details of a specific journal entry by its ID.

methods.name: createGLJournalEntry
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create new balanced journal entries, including different command modes such as updateRunningBalance and defineOpeningBalance.

methods.name: createReversalJournalEntry
methods.description: Handles POST requests to reverse a specific journal entry identified by transactionId, supporting commands like 'reverse'.

methods.name: retrieveJournalEntries
methods.description: Provides a simplified endpoint for retrieval of provisioning journal entries based on entryId.

methods.name: retrieveOpeningBalance
methods.description: Fetches opening balance information for a specified office and currency.

methods.name: getJournalEntriesTemplate
methods.description: Generates and returns an Excel template for bulk journal entry import.

methods.name: postJournalEntriesTemplate
methods.description: Handles file upload to import journal entries via a populated Excel template for bulk import.
